Lena Park: NovusEdge asked for a rapid joint throughput vs watt pilot next Tue. Scope: 3 models (micro, standard, long), seq lens 256/2048, batches [1,8,32], two kernel profiles (nv-std, nv-prefetch-off). Need clear artifact naming + power telemetry. Who picks this up?

Omar Khan: I can take kernel profiles and container build. Will push branch `novus/bench-profiles` and image `redwood/novus-bench:2026-03`. Kernel notes: nv-prefetch-off will disable L2 prefetch; add `no_turbo` to cpufreq for stability.

Sofia Ruiz: I'll reserve `novus-lab-2` and `novus-remote-a`. S3 path: `s3://redwood-partners/novusedge/pilot-0326/`. CSV schema we use:
```
run_id,model,seq_len,batch,tokens_per_s,avg_power_w,tokens_per_w,p50_ms,p95_ms,kernel_tag,container_sha,notes
```
Require `power_raw.csv` and `dmesg.log`. Also run a 150-prompt QA to check generation quality.

InfraBot: Jira PRJ-4120 created and calendar invite "NovusEdge perfW pilot" set for Tue 09:00 UTC. Vault path for keys: `vault/partners/novusedge/keys`.

Lena Park: Acceptance: tokens_per_w >=5% improvement with p95 latency <=10% regression to consider promotion. Omar, ping when images are uploaded so I can loop in NovusEdge ops.

Omar Khan: Will do, ETA images tonight.

Sofia Ruiz: I'll send partner checklist + wiring diagram once lab reservations finalize. :thumbsup:
